Prepositions in the text:
1. "onto" - connects the verb "jumped" to the noun phrase "the counter", indicating direction and destination.
2. "in" - connects the noun phrase "search" to the noun phrase "food", indicating the purpose or context of the search.
3. "of" - connects the noun "search" to the noun phrase "food", forming the prepositional phrase "in search of".
4. "of" - connects the adjective "unaware" to the noun phrase "the water spilled across the surface", indicating what the cat is unaware of.
5. "across" - connects the noun "water" to the noun "surface", indicating the spatial relationship or location of the water.

The shape with three sides is a triangle.
